limits: Creation validates the QA customer, two items at Rs 93.25, document discount 10%, total Rs 167.85, explicit 17-day validity and saved draft/accepted status. It does not certify the missing custom terms/notes capability.

bugs.title: Saved quotation View opens an invoice route and displays Invoice Not Found
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and open Quotations.
Create a quotation for QA Billing Automation Customer, select QA add mv9rtxw1-3b087e, set quantity 2, price Rs 93.25, 10% discount and a future expiry.
Save as Draft; confirm the record and Rs 167.85 total appear in the list.
Click the saved row's eye/View button.
Repeat with a newly created quotation using Mark Accepted & Save.
bugs.expected: View displays the saved quotation and its commercial details, status workflow, and invoice conversion action for accepted quotations.
bugs.actual: The eye action navigates to /app/invoicing/<quotation-id>. The page displays Invoice Not Found instead of the quotation; both draft and accepted records reproduce it.
bugs.comment: Fix the quotation row route/document resolver and provide its status and conversion actions. Retest all lifecycle branches and verify a converted invoice preserves items, prices, customer and totals. Multiple dependent failures are grouped here; no separate status/conversion defect is assumed.

bugs.title: Quotation editor has no custom payment terms, notes or per-line discount fields
steps: Select the QA billing customer and add a product row.
Inspect row pricing, customer details and Billing totals for commercial fields.
Try to set separate line discounts, custom payment terms and a negotiated note.
bugs.expected: Each line supports its own discount, and the quotation allows custom payment terms and notes that persist after saving.
bugs.actual: The editor exposes editable unit prices and a single document-level discount. No custom payment terms, notes or line discount controls are present. Deployed client payload sets notes to an empty string and generates fixed validity terms.
bugs.comment: Add the required editable commercial fields to creation/editing, persist them, and include them in the quotation output. The verified editable unit price/document discount is not a substitute for these explicit requirements.

bugs.title: Quotation PDF export reproduces the existing document export 404
steps: Create and save an isolated QA quotation.
In Quotations, click Download PDF on its row.
Inspect the actual popup URL and content.
bugs.expected: The action opens or downloads the selected quotation's branded, printable document.
bugs.actual: It opens public /invoicing/<quotation-id>?print=true outside /app and displays 404 / That page is not here.
bugs.comment: Update the existing RET-002 ticket rather than creating another export ticket. Correct both the application base path and quotation document routing; then validate actual output branding, content and printing.
